resources.string: Cards from other apps in the Watch row. Each one needs your OK.
Turn on only apps you trust. A plugin only sends a short text; it cannot see your apps or accounts.
No plugin installed. Plugins are apps from other developers that show a card here, like a match score or a price.
At most %1$d plugins at a time. Turn one off first.
If a plugin is updated with a different signature, it is turned off until you allow it again.
